description: Existing kitchen, 13 Nov 2026: sink wall base cabinets open: food containers, Dutch oven and casseroles; cleaning things under the sink; dishwasher

extractions.what: Sink-wall bases: nested deli containers and lids, round containers with red lids, divided lunch containers; below them a wok with a glass lid, a white casserole and a blue Dutch oven. Under the sink: three spray cleaners, Goo Gone, a dish soap refill, a tub of dishwasher tablets, paper towels, a cloth bag of bags; the disposal and a water filter. Bosch dishwasher
